description: The SVGW Wasserstatistik is the annual statistical survey that the Swiss gas and water association SVGW has run among its member water utilities for more than a hundred years; about 720 utilities now take part. It covers water abstraction and delivery, tariffs and finances, staff, energy and disruptions, with water treatment and pipe materials added every five years and special data on lake water works and on drinking water supply in emergencies. Coverage is the participating Swiss utilities. The published edition W15001 (Wasserstatistik 2022, operating year 2021, German and French) is a free PDF in the SVGW shop and infographics are on the site; data entry and further information for members are behind a login, and no licence is stated. Caveats: only member utilities that report are included, and the latest free edition found on the page is for operating year 2021. Simulation uses: utility-level delivery, energy use, disruptions and pipe material shares for capacity planning and resilience studies of Swiss water supply. Related records: DANVA Vand i tal (data-danva-vand-i-tal-danish-water-utility-statistics).
